definition: I. עָב , [ עֹב ] noun masculine architectural term, meaning unknown; projecting roof is conjectured ( Sm Co Berthol ); others landing ( Da ); AV RV thick beam or plank , RVm threshold ; Benz Kit Toy leave untranslated; in any case a structure of wood; — absolute וְעַמֻּדִים וְעָב 1Kgs 7:6 apparently construct וְעָב עֵץ אֶלפְּֿנֵי הָאוּלָם מֵהַחוּץ Ezek 41:25 plural (si vera lectio) הָעֻבִּים v Ezek 41:26 . II. עָב see עוּב .
